title: Anthropic ships Claude Agent SDK 0.3 with structured output
summary: The SDK now returns a json_schema-validated object alongside the final text, so callers stop parsing prose.

title: OpenAI opens GPT-5.5 fine-tuning to all API customers
summary: Fine-tuning moves out of limited preview; pricing is per million training tokens with a two-week retention default.

title: EU AI Act: first enforcement letters go out to eight providers
summary: Regulators asked for model cards and incident logs within 30 days; no fines yet, but the letters set the template.

title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3.5 tops the new ARC-AGI-3 board
summary: A 61% score on the new benchmark, up from 34% for the previous generation, with cost per task still above $2.

title: Mistral raises $900M at a $14B valuation to build sovereign inference
summary: The round is led by European pension funds; proceeds go to data centres in France and Sweden.

title: Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 weights under a revised licence
summary: The 400B model ships with a licence that drops the monthly-active-user cap that limited Llama 3.

title: MCP becomes a Linux Foundation project
summary: Anthropic hands the Model Context Protocol spec to a neutral foundation; Microsoft, Google and AWS join the board.

title: Nvidia's Rubin GPUs slip to Q1 2027 on HBM4 supply
summary: Two supply-chain sources put the delay at one quarter; Blackwell Ultra output rises to cover the gap.

title: Stanford HAI: agent benchmarks disagree with each other more than with humans
summary: Across 14 agent benchmarks, rank correlation between suites was 0.41, which the authors call a measurement problem.

title: Cursor and Replit report agents now write most merged code in their own repos
summary: Both companies put the figure above 70% of merged diffs, with review time rather than authoring as the new bottleneck.
